program.text:
<program>
task: vending machine credit in cents (price 50, at most 100)
input: the actions in order
events: nickel dime quarter buy refund
c: 0..100 step 5
start: c=0
on nickel: c+5 stay
on dime: c+10 stay
on quarter: c+25 stay
on buy: c-50 stay
on refund: c=000
answer: The display shows {c} cents.
</program>
